description: This file defines the LeadsListViewSmarty class, extending ListViewSmarty, providing custom processing and export link building for the leads list view in the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: LeadsListViewSmarty
classes.description: A subclass of ListViewSmarty that customizes behavior for the leads list view, including processing and export link generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class and sets the targetList property to true.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Customizes the processing of the list view, adding actions based on configuration, and manages export link visibility.

methods.name: buildExportLink
methods.description: Builds the export link HTML, including a JavaScript call and custom labels, conditionally based on permissions.
